abstract_sentences.text: Reliability is key to realizing the promise of autonomous UI-agents, multimodal agents that directly interact with the apps humans use, as users must be able to trust an agent to complete a given task.

evidence.anchor: Reliability is key ... trust an agent to complete a given task

abstract_sentences.text: Current evaluations rely on fixed environments—often clones of existing apps—which are limited in that they can only shed light on whether or how often an agent can complete a task within a specific environment.

evidence.anchor: Current evaluations rely on fixed environments

abstract_sentences.text: When deployed however, agents are likely to encounter variations in app design and content that can affect an agent’s ability to complete a task.

evidence.anchor: variations in app design and content

abstract_sentences.text: To address this blind spot of measuring agent reliability across app variations, we develop OpenApps, a light-weight open-source ecosystem with six apps (messenger, calendar, maps, etc.) that are configurable in appearance and content.

evidence.anchor: develop OpenApps ... six apps ... configurable

abstract_sentences.text: OpenApps requires just a single CPU to run, enabling easy generation and deployment of thousands of versions of each app.

evidence.anchor: single CPU ... thousands of versions

abstract_sentences.text: Specifically, we run more than 10,000 independent evaluations to study reliability across seven leading multimodal agents.

evidence.anchor: more than 10,000 independent evaluations ... seven leading multimodal agents

abstract_sentences.text: We find that while standard reliability within a fixed app is relatively stable, reliability can vary drastically when measured across app variations.

evidence.anchor: reliability can vary drastically ... app variations

abstract_sentences.text: Task success rates for many agents can fluctuate by more than 50% across app variations.

evidence.anchor: fluctuate by more than 50% across app variations

abstract_sentences.text: For example, Kimi-VL-3B’s average success across all tasks fluctuates from 63% to just 4% across app versions.

evidence.anchor: Kimi-VL-3B’s average success ... 63% to just 4%

abstract_sentences.text: We also find agent behaviors such as looping or hallucinating actions can differ drastically depending on the environment configuration.

evidence.anchor: looping or hallucinating actions

abstract_sentences.text: These initial findings highlight the importance of measuring reliability along this new dimension of app variations.

evidence.anchor: importance of measuring reliability ... app variations

final_judgment.single_storyline: 把 UI-agent reliability 从固定 app clone 内的 policy success 扩展为跨 app appearance/content variation 的 deployment reliability，再以 full-state reward、STD/MAD、failure behavior 和 screen-resolution case 操作化；证据在 PDF p. 6–10。
final_judgment.main_body_keeps: 正文保留六 app/single-CPU simulator、15 simple tasks、10,000+ evaluations、seven agents、fixed/across reliability 定义、Figures 4–6 和 resolution interaction，足以理解问题、方法和方向性结果；证据在 PDF p. 2、p. 4–10。
final_judgment.appendix_moves: YAML listing、visual variations、goal/action 清单、MAD、完整 task/model breakdown、interaction、multi-step、popular choices 与 Tables 11–13 移入 appendix；主结论方向仍自足，但分母、seed、异质性和 failure taxonomy 的复算依赖 p. 19–34。
final_judgment.best_pattern: Figure 5 的 paired fixed/across comparison 建立量级，Figure 6 把 appearance/content 变成两个可见 case，Table 7 用 dark theme 的反向 resolution pattern 打破单调部署叙事；证据在 PDF p. 8、p. 10、p. 28。
final_judgment.largest_gap: curated simulator 的跨 variation fluctuation 尚未由完整 factorial design、机制 manipulation 或真实 deployment 识别 contrast、language、distraction、parser/modality 的因果贡献；sim2real/training 仍是 future work，证据在 PDF p. 5、p. 8–10、p. 17–18、p. 29。
final_judgment.transfer_rule: 环境分布是部署对象时，把 variation 作为独立实验轴，报告 fixed baseline 与跨版本同一 estimand，并保留 behavior-level failure measure；OpenApps 的 STD/MAD、loops 和 invalid actions 提供了直接范式，证据在 PDF p. 6–9、p. 22–25。
final_judgment.transfer_boundary: 该规则适用于可重置、可定义 target state、variation 可控且 action 可记录的 simulator；缺少 full-state oracle、面对长时开放世界或无法对应真实部署时，跨版本 STD/MAD 只能作为 reliability signal，不能直接解释为现实部署因果效应，证据在 PDF p. 4–6、p. 10、p. 17–18。
